pins.title: pin gate
pins.ok: pin gate: OK (%(count)d pins all consistent)
pins.off: off (%(name)s does not exist ⇒ says so and exits 0; pluggable)
pins.explicit_spec_missing: explicitly specified spec %(name)s does not exist (--spec / REFLECT_PINS) — write the spec or drop the flag
pins.empty: pins is empty (zero-value guard: an empty assertion surface is not a pass)
pins.pin_missing_field: pin missing field %(field)s: %(entry)r (why/name are mandatory per family rule)
pins.worktree_missing: %(name)s: worktree %(path)s does not exist (the pointer is there, the tree is not)
pins.head_unreadable: %(name)s: worktree HEAD unreadable (not a git tree?)
pins.commit_mismatch: %(name)s: derived copy commit %(declared)s ≠ worktree HEAD %(actual)s (pointer bumped after provisioning?)
